empty.title: Plan your first story
empty.description: Story Atlas keeps each story’s plan beside its chapters: what it’s about, how long it should be and where you are with it. Only you see it.

signedOut: Sign in to plan your stories.
notFound: We couldn’t find that story among yours. It may have been deleted.
loadFailed: Your plan didn’t load. Check your connection and try again.
privateNote: Only you can see your plan.

save.failed: Not saved. What you typed is still here, and we’ll try again when you next change it.

details.heading: Story details
details.sharedHint: The title, genre and audience are the story’s own: changing them here changes them in Story settings too.
details.title: Title
details.loglineHint: The story in a sentence or two, to remind yourself what it’s about.
details.wordTargetInvalid: Use a whole number of words, from 1 to 5,000,000.

linked.heading: Linked project
linked.hint: A project of yours outside {{productName}}, such as a shared folder or a mood board.
linked.label: Name
linked.addressHint: The full address, starting with https://
linked.invalid: Use a full web address that starts with http:// or https://.

delete.heading: Delete this story
delete.note: Its whole plan goes with it.

characters.heading: Characters
characters.filterHint: By name, or by what they’re also known as.
characters.none: No characters yet. Add the first with New character.
characters.pick: Choose a character to open their sheet.
characters.notFound: That character isn’t in this story any more.
characters.createFailed: The character wasn’t added. Check your connection and try again.
characters.name: Name

hints.also_known_as: Other names and nicknames, separated by commas.
hints.age_or_born: An age, or the year they were born.
hints.life_status: For example alive, dead or undead.

custom.heading: Your own fields
custom.none: No fields of your own yet.
custom.manage: Add or remove your own fields on the at-a-glance page

picture.heading: Picture
picture.none: No picture yet, so the initials show.
picture.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. It’s checked before it shows, and only you see it.
picture.altHint: For anyone who can’t see it.
picture.removeFailed: The picture wasn’t removed. Check your connection and try again.
picture.checking: Your picture is being checked. It shows here once it passes.
picture.waiting_for_person: A person on our team will look at this picture first.
picture.removed: The moderation team removed this picture.

delete.heading: Delete this character
delete.confirm: Delete {{name}}? Their picture goes too, and this can’t be undone.
delete.failed: The character wasn’t deleted. Check your connection and try again.

fieldsSection.heading: Your character fields
fieldsSection.hint: A field you add here shows on every character’s sheet in this story, such as “Turned by”.
fieldsSection.none: No fields of your own yet.
fieldsSection.name: New field
fieldsSection.removedNote: Removed: hidden from the sheets, with what you wrote kept.
fieldsSection.failed: That didn’t save. Check your connection and try again.
